description: Rørledninger is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Sokkeldirektoratet. Rørledningssystem med tilhørende installasjoner, utgjør transportsystemene for petroleum fra Norsk kontinentalsokkel. Coverage: Sokkeldirektoratet. The publisher named on the listing is Sokkeldirektoratet. Its keywords include gass, modellbaserteVegprosjekter, Transportsystemer, Inspire, Rørledninger, geodataloven. The listing shows 2 download or service links in ZIP, SHP. The listing shows 2020-05-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data 1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
